svg.title: Two routes between two zeros
svg.desc: The original 2/3 and 4/7 curves have zero tangent turns. Their one-third straight blend has minus two; the one-third angle-and-distance blend has zero. Below each drawing, its velocity trace winds around a white dot with the same count.
svg.text: The straight blend makes cusps near 22.63% and 50.89%. The angle-and-distance route keeps moving.
Every drawing winds +1 around its center. Equal axis scales within each diagram. Aldebaran · Study 005
